structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. I'll ask my son or the bank. I couldn't tell from this page which track is as safe as my deposit. Maybe "כספי (שקלי)" is, at around 4.4%, but nothing said so, and the fees all looked about the same, around 0.6%.

stuck.where: Screen 1, row of buttons under 'במה הכסף מושקע'
stuck.why: Full of words I don't know (s&p 500, עוקב מדד, קיימה, גמיש). I didn't know which one is the safe one.
I couldn't tell if that's per year or for all three years together. The heading 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת' was far up, out of sight.

stuck.where: Rows showing 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number
stuck.why: I didn't understand why there's no number, or whether that's bad.
I didn't know what the circle shows or how it matches the two percentages beside it.

used: Heading 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות' and the lit 'קופת גמל להשקעה 143' button
Company names: הראל, מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, הפניקס, ילין לפידות, מגדל
Rows 'כספי (שקלי)' and their returns of about 4.3%-4.6%

The company summary lines (נכסים, range of fees)

The arrows at the end of each row
unsure_meaning: עוד לא דווח with an orange circle
not_found: A plain sentence saying which track is safe like a deposit
An explanation of what כספי (שקלי) means
Whether the fees are high or low compared to the bank

findings.what: Dark black screen, small grey writing, hard to read even with glasses
Every row repeats the same words (מניות, מט"ח, ההחיסכון, ההפקדה, 3 שנים, 5 שנים) and I had to read them again each time
Nothing says which track is safe or what each track means for someone afraid of losses
I can't tell whether the return is per year or for all the years
Lots of numbers on every screen, and I got anxious
The opening buttons are full of English and terms I don't know
The circle and its percentages are separate, so I had to look back and forth
A warning strip about data not updated, and 'עוד לא דווח' with an orange mark, and I didn't know if it was dangerous
findings.where: Screen 1, and rows on screens 2, 4 and 5

findings.what: Very long list with no end in sight. I got tired before the end
